description: A shell script containing tests for verifying the behavior of 'git submodule absorbgitdirs'. It sets up various scenarios involving Git submodules, performs operations to absorb the submodule git directories into the main repository, and checks for correct migration and error handling.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, running the provided shell commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Checks that the provided command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Verifies that the provided output is empty.

methods.name: test_config_global
methods.description: Sets a global git configuration for testing.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit in the specified directory with a given message.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the commit timestamp to ensure unique commits.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs for equality.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after tests complete.
